# Weekly review 2026-W47

## What went well
The migration to the new sync service finished on Tuesday. We moved 1,240 notes without a single conflict, and the backup job ran every night. Maria wrote the onboarding checklist, which cut the setup time for new people from two hours to forty minutes.

## What did not go well
The search index was rebuilt three times because of a bad cache key. Each rebuild took about 25 minutes and blocked the reviewers. We also missed the Thursday deadline for the client report, because the figures from finance arrived late.

## Next week
- Freeze the schema before Monday noon.
- Ask finance for the figures by Wednesday.
- Write a short guide on how to rebuild the index safely.
- Plan the retrospective with the whole team on Friday afternoon.
